sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַכְּחָל – קוֹרְעוֹ וּמוֹצִיא אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ. לֹא קְרָעוֹ – אֵינוֹ עוֹבֵר עָלָיו. הַלֵּב – קוֹרְעוֹ וּמוֹצִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ, לֹא קְרָעוֹ – אֵינוֹ עוֹבֵר עָלָיו.

positions.claim: One who wants to eat the udder tears it and removes its milk first; if he did not tear it, he does not transgress the meat-and-milk prohibition on account of it
positions.basis: the milk contained in the udder does not have the status of forbidden milk

positions.claim: One who wants to eat the heart tears it and removes its blood first; if he did not tear it, he does not transgress on account of it
